narrative: The loose leaf. Under the first line, a second line begun and already smeared. The red knot is in the same place. No face. The second line is gone. A thumb has the ink on it. He does not open the bundle to compare. No face. One line left, and a pale rub beneath it. The candle is shorter. No face.
